about_the_game:
This digital content will not only enhance your gaming experience, but bring the legacy of the Aztecs right into your home.

Exclusive Temple Skin
Enjoy a special skin for your temple, the heart and soul of your city creation, only available in the Digital Supporter Pack.

Digital Wallpapers
Customize your rig with some impressions from Aztecs: The Last Sun - brought to you by the art & design team of the developer.

content_descriptors.notes: The game is based on historically accurate data and takes place in the early days of the Aztecs, focusing on the founding and expansion of the city-state of Tenochtitlán. Human sacrifice, which was a part of this culture, has been integrated into gameplay. Players will be confronted with this on an abstracted level.
